@@U00565@@
Then you'll be the man! Then you'll be the clever one! You're well built—well enough, at least— you're not backward, not lacking in sense, so trust yourself and others will trust you. But above all else, learn to manage women! Their eternal moaning and groaning, their thousand pains and complaints, so multifarious in their variety, can be cured with a bit of pressure at the right point. A soupcon of discretion, and you'll have them eating out of your hand. First, of course, it helps to be an M.D.; it makes them assume your skill and you win their confidence. You'll have opened for you all the riches of the Orient, luxurious gardens vast in number, that ordinary men spend years trying to conquer. No delay for you, though: a fumble here, a fumble there, you finger the merchandise. You'll know just where to squeeze that little pulse, then clasp her round her slender hips to see how tightly she’s laced.

@@U00567@@
That’s more like it! At least you know what you're after.

@@U00569@@
Dear friend, theory is a gray affair, and the golden tree of life is green.

@@U00571@@
It’s all like a dream, I swear. May I trouble you again, and truly get to the bottom of your wisdom?

@@U00565@@
那你就是男人了！那你就是那个聪明的人了！你身体素质很好——至少足够好——你并不落后，也不缺乏理智，所以相信自己，别人也会信任你。但最重要的是，学会管理女性！他们永恒的呻吟和呻吟，他们数以千计的痛苦和抱怨，种类繁多，可以在适当的时候用一点压力来治愈。 A soupcon of discretion, and you'll have them eating out of your hand.首先，当然，成为一名医学博士是有帮助的；这会让他们认可你的技能，并赢得他们的信任。 You'll have opened for you all the riches of the Orient, luxurious gardens vast in number, that ordinary men spend years trying to conquer. No delay for you, though: a fumble here, a fumble there, you finger the merchandise.你会知道在哪里挤压那个小脉搏，然后将她抱住她纤细的臀部，看看她的系带有多紧。

@@U00567@@
那就更像了！至少你知道自己在追求什么。

@@U00569@@
亲爱的朋友，理论是灰色的事情，而生命的金树是绿色的。

@@U00571@@
这一切就像一场梦，我发誓。能否再麻烦您一下，真正探究一下您的智慧？
